title: Cinema Platform / Infrastructure
description: The server (node-exporter), PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ and the monitoring stack

panels.title: Load (1m) per core
panels.description: Above 1 means processes are waiting for CPU

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: iowait high = waiting for the disk; steal high = the VPS host is busy

panels.title: Disk space
panels.description: Logs are capped at 30 MB per container; Prometheus keeps 7 days, Loki 7 days

panels.title: Memory by Node service
panels.description: Databases, RabbitMQ and the monitoring stack use the rest

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Reads served from memory. Below 99% the database doesn't fit in RAM.

panels.title: Transactions by database
panels.description: Rollbacks also come from unique violations (e.g. a seat that's already taken)

panels.title: Hit ratio
panels.description: Misses are normal for OTP codes that already expired

panels.title: Keys and expirations
panels.description: Evicted > 0 means Redis ran out of memory and threw keys away
